{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]
__NOTOC__
==Ingredients==
{{metricate}}

=== Pastry ===
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (454 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:Phyllo dough|phyllo dough]]
*4–5 [[cookbook:cup|cup]] [[cookbook:walnuts|walnuts]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] coarsely
*½ cup white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
*¼ [[cookbook:tsp|tsp]] [[wikt:ground|ground]] [[cookbook:clove|cloves]]
*1 tsp [[cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*¾ pound (340 g) sweet [[cookbook:butter|butter]]

=== Syrup ===
*2 ½ cups of [[cookbook:water|water]]
*3 cups white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
*3 tsp [[cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
*1 tsp [[cookbook:vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]

==Procedure==

=== Pastry ===
#Combine nuts, cinnamon, cloves, and sugar. Melt butter in a [[cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]].
#Use a pastry [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] to brush inside of a 14 x 10.5-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (36 x 27 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) pan with melted butter. 
#Line bottom of pan with one piece of Phyllo dough. Fold under excess Phyllo.
#Alternate sides with each piece of Phyllo, brushing the top of each layer with melted butter.
#Repeat 5 times, making 5 layers.
#On the 6th sheet, sprinkle evenly with nut mixture.
#Continue until all nut mixture is used and last 6 buttered sheets of Phyllo form top crust.
#Use a sharp knife to cut into diamond shapes.
#[[cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at 300 °F (150 °C) for about 1 ½ hours or until lightly brown.

=== Syrup ===
#Combine syrup ingredients. [[cookbook:Boil|Boil]] syrup for about 10 minutes and then allow to cool. 
#Pour cooled syrup over hot pastry. Enjoy!
